configurePresets.name: legacy
configurePresets.description: SDLDrv + OpenGLDrv. Native regression/reference renderer. Builds in build-legacy/.

configurePresets.name: gl4es
configurePresets.description: SDL2Drv + GL4ESDrv. Web-aligned native stack. Builds in build-gl4es/.

configurePresets.name: physics
configurePresets.description: gl4es stack with WITH_PHYSICS=ON. Builds in build-physics/.

configurePresets.name: karma-ref
configurePresets.description: gl4es stack with BUILD_KARMA_REF=ON (32-bit Karma reference). Builds in build-karma-ref/.

configurePresets.name: gl4es-full
configurePresets.description: gl4es stack with BUILD_KARMA_REF + USE_PIXOMATIC. One binary: GL4ES + Karma physics + the -SOFTWARERENDERER (Pixomatic) device. Builds in build-gl4es-full/.

configurePresets.name: legacy-full
configurePresets.description: legacy stack with BUILD_KARMA_REF + USE_PIXOMATIC — proves the single PixoDrv source also builds on SDL 1.2. Builds in build-legacy-full/.

configurePresets.name: wasm
configurePresets.description: Emscripten gl4es web build: -O2 + DWARF + assertions + exception catching. The everyday dev build — named stacks and readable errors while the engine still runs at a playable speed. NOT the small one: DWARF plus un-cleaned-up inlining makes it the largest of the three. Builds in build-wasm/. Run `source ~/emsdk/emsdk_env.sh` first (sets EMSDK).

configurePresets.name: wasm-debug
configurePresets.description: Emscripten gl4es web build: -O0, nothing inlined, every local live. Reach for it when the OPTIMISER is the suspect — a bug that shows at one -O level and not another is almost always undefined behaviour. ~5x the wasm and a much slower boot. Builds in build-wasm-debug/.

configurePresets.name: wasm-perf
configurePresets.description: Emscripten gl4es web build: -O3, assertions off, no debug info -> smaller/faster. Builds in build-wasm-perf/. Run `source ~/emsdk/emsdk_env.sh` first.

configurePresets.name: windows
configurePresets.displayName: Windows x86 (MinGW-w64) -- legacy SDL1.2 + desktop OpenGL
configurePresets.description: 32-bit Windows build, cross-compiled from Linux via cmake/toolchain-mingw-w64.cmake; the same preset works from an MSYS2 MINGW32 prompt. Uses the LEGACY stack (SDL 1.2 + desktop OpenGL) deliberately: GL4ES translates desktop GL *to* GLES2, which Linux drivers ship and Windows drivers generally do not, so on Windows the real opengl32 is already there and the translation layer only adds a dependency. Linux keeps both stacks. SDL 1.2 comes from SDL's prebuilt MinGW binaries (cmake/SDL12Mingw.cmake) — an IMPORT library, so SDL.dll ships beside the exe. Builds in build-windows/. [ufront 2.33]
